issues.title: Save and reload one observation
issues.outcome: User can save an observation and see it after reload
acceptance: Invalid text produces an actionable error
tests: UI save/reload through API and temporary storage
issues.vertical_check: Enter text, save, reload the view and observe the same text

issues.title: Download a project summary
issues.outcome: User can download a summary of existing project metadata
acceptance: Download contains the current project name and owner
tests: Request download and compare parsed contents with fixture project
issues.vertical_check: Click download in the existing project page and open the generated summary

issues.title: Edit an observation with conflict feedback
issues.outcome: User can edit saved text without silently overwriting concurrent changes
tests: Two clients editing the same revision
issues.vertical_check: Save, edit and reload; use a stale second tab to observe a conflict

issues.title: Show the conflict message in the user's language
issues.outcome: A review finding on issue 3: the stale-edit conflict reads in the user's language
acceptance: The conflict message of a stale edit is translated
tests: Stale edit in a second tab shows the translated message
issues.vertical_check: Edit in a stale tab and read the translated conflict message
